# Rate My UX

> Rate My UX (https://www.ratemyux.com) is an AI-powered UX evaluation and design auditing platform. Powered by neural Vision AI models, it analyzes website URLs, mobile screenshots, and Figma prototypes across 11 usability dimensions—delivering Nielsen heuristic audits, WCAG 2.2 accessibility checks, conversion rate optimization insights, and prioritized redesign roadmaps in seconds.

Rate My UX helps product managers, UI/UX designers, developers, and founders instantly discover UX friction, usability defects, visual layout issues, and accessibility bottlenecks before shipping to production.

## Primary Pages

- [Rate My UX Home & AI Evaluator](https://www.ratemyux.com/): Interactive AI-powered UX evaluator tool supporting URL crawling, image drop, Figma prototype review, and instant usability reporting.
- [Rate My UX Blog & Knowledge Center](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog): 16+ expert UX guides, Nielsen heuristic breakdowns, WCAG 2.2 checklists, and AI UX engineering playbooks.
- [About Rate My UX](https://www.ratemyux.com/about): Information about Rate My UX, our neural Vision AI methodology, 11-dimension evaluation framework, and design auditing standards.
- [Pricing & Subscription Plans](https://www.ratemyux.com/plans): Detailed comparison of Free ($0/mo), Pro ($29/mo), and Team ($79/mo) plans with multi-screen auditing and export features.
- [Contact & Support](https://www.ratemyux.com/contact): Contact form for support inquiries, custom enterprise design audits, feedback, and sales.
- [User Dashboard](https://www.ratemyux.com/dashboard): View complete past audit history, track usability scores over time, and export executive PDF reports.
- [Profile & Security](https://www.ratemyux.com/profile): Manage user credentials, Google OAuth integration, and strong password generation.

## Key Features & Capabilities

- [Live URL Crawling & Multi-Screen Audit](https://www.ratemyux.com/): Crawls live web applications, captures full-page viewport screenshots, and evaluates user flows across key user journeys.
- [Figma Prototype & Image Upload](https://www.ratemyux.com/): Drag-and-drop support for PNG, JPG, WebP screenshots and Figma design frames for instant pre-launch usability audits.
- [11-Dimension Vision AI Analysis](https://www.ratemyux.com/about): Comprehensive scoring engine evaluating layout, typography, contrast, visual hierarchy, mobile touch targets, and CRO friction points.
- [Nielsen Heuristic Checkups](https://www.ratemyux.com/about): Automated mapping against Jakob Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics for interaction design.
- [WCAG 2.2 Accessibility Auditing](https://www.ratemyux.com/about): Automated checks for contrast compliance, font legibility, touch target spacing, and screen reader structure.
- [Executive Summary & PDF Export](https://www.ratemyux.com/): Downloadable executive-ready PDF audit reports with action items and redesign recommendations.

- [How to Conduct an AI-Powered UX Audit in 2026](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/how-to-conduct-ai-ux-audit-in-2026): 5-step framework for using multimodal vision models to audit interfaces.

- [Vision AI vs Manual UX Audits Benchmark](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/ai-in-ux-design-vision-models-vs-manual-audits): Empirical comparison across 50 production websites.
- [Figma to Code: Preventing UX Degradation](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/figma-to-production-ux-qa-handshake): Token synchronization and design QA during developer handoff.
- [Minimizing Cognitive Load in SaaS Dashboards](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/cognitive-load-in-saas-dashboard-design): Progressive disclosure and visual noise reduction.
- [Ecommerce Checkout UX Teardown](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/checkout-ux-teardown-ecommerce-cart-abandonment): Eliminating the 7 friction points that cause 70% cart abandonment.
- [Dark Mode UX Design: Contrast & Halation](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/color-contrast-and-dark-mode-ux-rules): Contrast rules, surface elevation, and halation prevention.
- [The Psychology of Micro-Interactions](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/micro-interactions-and-feedback-loops-guide): Dan Saffer's 4-part model for perceived performance.
- [Form Design Masterclass: Inline Validation](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/form-ux-best-practices-inline-validation): Reward early, punish late inline error recovery patterns.
- [Information Architecture: Card Sorting & Tree Testing](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/information-architecture-card-sorting-tree-testing): Structuring sitemaps and nested menus.
- [Design Token Foundations: 8pt Spacing & Typography](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/design-system-tokens-spacing-typography-scale): Mathematical spacing scales and CSS clamp formulas.
- [B2B Enterprise UX: Onboarding & Activation](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/b2b-enterprise-ux-onboarding-activation-flows): Interactive checklists to accelerate Time-to-Value.
- [AEO & GEO for Product Designers](https://www.ratemyux.com/blog/aeo-geo-search-engine-optimization-for-designers): Answer engine indexing strategies for Perplexity and ChatGPT Search.

## Pricing Tiers

- [Free Tier](https://www.ratemyux.com/plans): $0/month — 3 screen evaluations per month with full 11-dimension scoring, Nielsen checks, and PDF export.
- [Pro Tier](https://www.ratemyux.com/plans): $29/month — Unlimited evaluations, up to 10 screens per audit, prioritized effort vs impact roadmap, and AI wireframes.
- [Team Tier](https://www.ratemyux.com/plans): $79/month — 5 team seats, unlimited screens, white-label PDF reports, and custom heuristic criteria.
- [Enterprise Tier](https://www.ratemyux.com/plans): Custom pricing — Dedicated API access, custom UX design review sessions, and SLA guarantees.
